introduction.text: The Sun is a hot, glowing ball of hydrogen and helium. Without its energy, life as we know it could not exist on Earth.

photosphere.title: HMI continuum mosaic CR2311
photosphere.summary: Visible surface and sunspots, assembled from May–June 2026 observations. Orange is false color; polar gaps are filled.

magnetic.title: HMI radial magnetic field CR2311
magnetic.summary: Magnetic field pointing into or out of the Sun, assembled from May–June 2026 observations.

chromosphere.title: AIA 304 Å synoptic map CR2311
chromosphere.summary: False-color 304 Å observations of the lower atmosphere, combined over 12 May–9 June 2026.

corona.title: AIA 171 Å synoptic map CR2311
corona.summary: A false-color mosaic of 171 Å ultraviolet light from the outer atmosphere, observed 12 May–9 June 2026.

cor1-density.title: COR1-B density CR2053 · μ=10
cor1-density.summary: STEREO-B reconstruction from 4–18 February 2007, using the archive μ=10 regularization and a display-only radial taper.

corona-193.title: AIA 193 Å synoptic map CR2311
corona-193.summary: 193 Å measurements reveal structures in the outer atmosphere. False-color mosaic, 12 May–9 June 2026.
